author.description: Author or authors as reported by the source.

license.description: Component license or license expression as reported by the source.

purl.description: Package URL identifying this component, preserving the pkg: URI form.

related-component.description: PURL of the related component. Use one object per distinct dependency relation so its relationship and target remain paired.

relationship.description: Relationship from this component to related-component, for example Depends On.

sha256.description: Component SHA-256 selected by the fingerprint algorithm; omit when another algorithm was supplied.

type.description: Component kind such as Library or Framework.

description: A component in a software bill of materials, including its package URL, version, license, integrity and a dependency relation to another component. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/software_component.
name: software-component
